cd /Users/2a/.picoclaw/workspace/scripts && uv run translate-image.py -i ARQUIVO_ORIGINAL -f /Users/2a/.picoclaw/workspace/media/jobs/DW9-2ObDiuS/translated/NOME_ptbr.png

3. Ler a legenda em /Users/2a/.picoclaw/workspace/media/jobs/DW9-2ObDiuS/images/ig_DW9-2ObDiuS_caption.txt e traduzir para PT-BR. Adaptar CTA (ex: "Comenta CREAR" → "Comenta claude").

cd /Users/2a/.picoclaw/workspace/scripts/instagram && python3 post.py /Users/2a/.picoclaw/workspace/media/jobs/DW9-2ObDiuS/translated/ig_DW9-2ObDiuS_1_ptbr.png [/Users/2a/.picoclaw/workspace/media/jobs/DW9-2ObDiuS/translated/ig_DW9-2ObDiuS_2_ptbr.png ...] "LEGENDA_TRADUZIDA"
cd /Users/2a/.picoclaw/workspace/scripts/instagram && python3 post.py --account agentesintegrados /Users/2a/.picoclaw/workspace/media/jobs/DW9-2ObDiuS/translated/ig_DW9-2ObDiuS_1_ptbr.png [...] "LEGENDA_TRADUZIDA"
cd /Users/2a/.picoclaw/workspace/scripts/instagram && python3 post.py --account openclawde /Users/2a/.picoclaw/workspace/media/jobs/DW9-2ObDiuS/translated/ig_DW9-2ObDiuS_1_ptbr.png [...] "LEGENDA_TRADUZIDA"
(post.py converte PNG→JPG automaticamente e limita a 10 imagens)

5. Gerar PDF:
python3 -c "
from PIL import Image; import os, glob, re
base = '/Users/2a/.picoclaw/workspace/media/jobs/DW9-2ObDiuS/translated'
files = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(base, 'ig_DW9-2ObDiuS_*_ptbr.png')), key=lambda f: int(re.search(r'_(\d+)_ptbr', f).group(1)))
imgs = [Image.open(f).convert('RGB') for f in files]
out = os.path.join(base, 'DW9-2ObDiuS_completo.pdf')
imgs[0].save(out, save_all=True, append_images=imgs[1:])
print(out)
"

6. Postar o PDF como documento/carrossel no LinkedIn:
